items.label: BEDSIDE SHELF ORGANIZER
items.value: This space saving shelf organizer is suitable for holding mobile phones,remotes,glasses,books,clip lights,tissues,scissors,lipstick,hair accessories,data cables,headphones,mail envelopes, keys, tools,jewelry,other little things. Keeps it neater than tossing them on a tabletop. If you have a loft bed or have an RV, this shelf must be a lifesaver. Choose it !

items.label: DURABLE & SIMPLE DESIGN
items.value: This shelf organizer is made of high quality plastic, makes it very sturdy and stable. It can be used as a shelf for ,bedroom,bathroom cabinet ,student dorm,apartment,RV,office etc. We use hollow design at the bottom of 2 slots to ensure no dust buildup. The 4 hooks at the bottom is convenient to hang some small items like hair ties.

items.label: SIZE
items.value: Square shape in 8.6 inch*8.6 inch size. We compare the A5 paper with our shelf, you can clearly understand the size. The depth of the 2 storage space is 1 inch and 1.7inch.

items.label: EASY TO INSTALL
items.value: Fast&No drilling installation, zero harm to the wall. Use the 5 Double sided tape to stick the bedside shelf to the wall perfectly. The adhesive is very strong enough to hold up 10 lbs. Please watch our installation video,remember you must wipe the walls(not wall paper) clean before you use the tapes.

items.label: PACKAGE INCLUDE & CUSTOMER SERVICE
items.value: The package comes with 1 x wall shelf, 5 x Double sided tape. Please keep in contact before and after you receive the order. We always persist in providing the best shopping experience to our customers.

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Use the 5 Double sided tape to stick the bedside shelf to the wall perfectly. Wipe the walls clean before using the tapes.
